text: {"standards":[{"code":"W.6.2","verdict":"partly","reason":"The Plan the Essay and Visual activity has students select evidence and organize an outline, but no activity has them draft or write the informative essay itself."},{"code":"W.6.2.a","verdict":"taught","reason":"The Building and Rehearsing a Thesis activity has students write a thesis, and the Plan the Essay and Visual activity has them choose comparison or classification and plan a chart, concept map, or collage."},{"code":"W.6.5","verdict":"taught","reason":"The Plan the Essay and Visual partner check has students revise one part of their outline based on peer feedback, which is planning and revising with peer support."},{"code":"W.6.8","verdict":"partly","reason":"The Plan the Essay and Visual activity tells students to quote or paraphrase with a source note, but no activity has them assess source credibility or write full bibliographic information."},{"code":"SL.6.5","verdict":"partly","reason":"Students plan a visual for the essay, but the Launch only mentions the later seminar or podcast and no activity has students build multimedia or visual displays for a presentation."}],"anchorText":{"verdict":"missing","reason":"The Lesson never names The Lightning Thief; it refers only to unit myths such as Arachne and Narcissus and to a placeholder model essay, so the outline's named text is not used."}}
